svg.title: Mercury-2.5: 340 environment and difficulty-tuple rows
svg.desc: One square per environment-specific tuple row. Color shows pass fraction; gray marks unscored rows. Numbers indicate rows containing more than one case. Columns across different environments do not denote common configurations.
